annotations.category_path: Federal Subsidy Rates for Student Loans, Federal Credit Reform Act Estimates / Repayment Plansa / Fixed Term / GradPLUS
annotations.variable_note: Shifting loan volume from one type of repayment plan to another would not necessarily result in the change in subsidy rates shown. Some borrowers, who have certain characteristics or certain amounts of debt, are more likely to enroll in IDR plans than in fixed-repayment plans. In addition, because the Department of Education plans to transfer delinquent loans in fixed-repayment plans to the new Saving on a Valuable Education IDR plan, the subsidy rates shown for fixed-repayment loans are based on an assumption of very low default rates.
